authority: Prospective finite workshop release evaluation; implementation choices, not source-derived empirical claims.
heldout: All ten unified seeds reserved at U1. Deterministic seed-to-case mapping is published. No R21C reserved seeds are used. These combinations are not executed before the release freeze; only seed 3101-3105 development cases are used for harness checks.
world_contract: Existing finite U4/U6/U12 laws and prices; no regeneration. New material labels, wear thresholds, initial supplies and mixed type groups are setup inputs. Initial blame episodes are supplied facts; attribution, proposals, procedures, consent and enacted effects are runtime outputs. Autonomy starts with four care units, sufficient for its positive three-use demand even at initial wear two.

gates.full_regressions: 445 inherited native + 840 legacy adapter + 72 independent fidelity + all U14 tests, no failures/errors/skips
gates.population: 24 repeated practice opportunities plus trials in each case, with independent records for all failures. Abundant: 24/24 successful. Scarce: at least 6 successful and at least one visible unsuccessful opportunity. Three exact partial continuations in every case. Paid newcomer acquisition and consented succession required.
gates.autonomy: Every history audited, all three checkpoint branches continue identically; safe funded declared positive cases must satisfy standing demand within 480 scheduling opportunities. Broken tools and resource limits may yield named waits or censored work and are reported separately.
gates.generalization: All 16 types in matched hidden-state and anticipation ablation controls. Ten novel receiver-composition and ten nested group cases must perform exactly; completion must survive interrupted work.
gates.inspector: Read-only actor export, explicit evaluator mode, exact revision lookup, gzip loading and inert HTML text verified.
gates.performance: Fresh sequential comparison: two inherited interaction contexts, two common history-1000 workloads, native shared/unique/dense at 1000 objects, and shared at 100 and 10000. Retain U13 .85 primary active/live/interaction ratios and per-case guards; native shared history growth <=2. Full U13 95-gate panel remains prior measured evidence, adopted only through exact source/protocol/fixture hashes; no claim of fresh rerun of its two large legacy checkpoint timing cases.

failure_policy: Retain every planned outcome, traceback, partial checkpoint and development error. Runtime change after a held-out failure consumes that panel as diagnostic evidence; any revised claim needs a separately frozen additional panel. Harness-only fixes retain original failure and receive explicit amendment. Never weaken a gate to pass.
execution: Functional workers may execute independently in parallel (up to six per panel). All timing comparisons run sequentially after all functional workers stop. Functional elapsed timings are descriptive.
amendment: Inspector-only recursive JSON conversion for identity and dataclass records, plus one complete-export regression. The first execution was interrupted and retained in interrupted_exporter_v1, including source-mutation rejections during shutdown. Runtime, policies, cases, allocations, horizons and acceptance thresholds are unchanged. All panels are reexecuted under this amended manifest; no behavior was tuned on their outcomes.
